title: Warranty Coverage Termination Clause: Voided and Expired Registrations
content:
**Clause.** A Warranty Coverage registration is voided when a void cause is recorded for the covered units: the units were removed from the home, the opening was structurally altered by others, or the home was destroyed. A registration is voided only on a recorded void cause, never on a customer's statement alone. Aftermarket glass film is an exclusion for glass claims, not a void cause. Voided and expired registrations accept no further claims, and charges already owed on them stay owed.

## Void causes by plan

| Plan | Void causes |
|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | units removed from the home; opening structurally altered by others; home destroyed |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | units removed from the home; opening structurally altered by others; home destroyed |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | units removed from the home; opening structurally altered by others; home destroyed |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | units removed from the home; opening structurally altered by others; home destroyed |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | units removed from the home; opening structurally altered by others; home destroyed |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | units removed from the home; opening structurally altered by others; home destroyed |

## Authority

Voiding rests on a void cause recorded in the system for the covered units of that registration. What the customer says, without such a record, does not void a registration.

## Effects

| Registration status | New claims | Charges already owed |
|---|---|---|
| voided | none accepted | stay owed |
| expired | none accepted | stay owed |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. A customer says the windows were taken out during a remodel, but no void cause is recorded. The registration is not voided on that statement.
2. Aftermarket film was applied to the glass. The registration is not voided; glass claims caused by the film fall under the exclusions.
3. A registration is voided while a trip charge remains unpaid. The trip charge stays owed.
